any.pattern: specified module could not be found

verdict: ccmsetup failed loading `PolicyAgentProvider.dll`. The Windows `CWDIllegalInDllSearch` safe-DLL-search policy is set to `0xFFFFFFFF`, which blocks the DLL from loading during MSI custom actions.
fix: From an elevated prompt: `reg query HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\Session` Manager /v CWDIllegalInDllSearch`. If the value is `0xFFFFFFFF`, either delete the registry value or lower it (`0x00000002` is the Microsoft-recommended hardening value that does not break client.msi). Alternatively, add `C:\Windows\CCM` to the machine `PATH` environment variable so the loader finds the DLL without CWD search. Retry ccmsetup after the change.
